title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Epoisses Clay Pot
description: A rich and snappy Vietnamese dish featuring Epoisses cheese, cooked in a bamboo tray to create a light and flavorful meal, FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, fish sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger.
Place the chicken breast in the bamboo tray and brush the vinegar mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Crumble the Epoisses cheese over the top of the chicken breast.
Drizzle the garlic-infused oil over the cheese and chicken.
Arrange the sliced bamboo shoots around the chicken in the bamboo tray.
Sprinkle the chopped scallions and sesame seeds over the top of the dish.
Place the bamboo tray in the oven and roast for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Oven Roasted Vietnamese Epoisses Clay Pot hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
